_comment: WCC visit file. Derived from data/LAZ_072226_001_R001.json, extended with the per camera parameters wccCtrl needs: TARGET_ACQUISITION.TA_SENSORS, TARGET_X_PIX and TARGET_Y_PIX on each star, the fine guiding EXP_TIME_FG / FRAME_RATE_FG / ROI_W_FG / ROI_H_FG, and the TRACKING handoff block. Every added field has a default, so an original LAZ format file still loads.
_comment_pointing: Boresight the telescope is asked for. This sample uses the gsc31_north.csv field centre so it runs against the bundled catalog.

TARGET_ACQUISITION._comment: CONFIG_SENSORS lists the sensors an astrometric solution is computed on. Solving several at once is what separates a pointing error from a roll error.
TARGET_ACQUISITION._comment_tol: Acceptance radii and the iteration limit. 50 pixels at 0.00994 arcsec/pixel is about 0.5 arcsec.
TARGET_ACQUISITION._comment_sensors: Per sensor overrides for the full frame acquisition pass. Anything omitted falls back to the TA_ defaults above. STREAM false drops a sensor out of the solution without removing it from the array.

_comment_guide: Ranked guide star candidates. X_WCC and Y_WCC are boresight relative field angles in arcseconds, with X_WCC running opposite to increasing right ascension. TARGET_X_PIX and TARGET_Y_PIX are the full sensor pixel the star is to be placed on; omit them to use the sensor centre. wccCtrl walks the ranks and takes the first whose guide and roll star both land on configured sensors.
_comment_roll: Roll star candidates. A roll star far from the boresight and well separated from the guide star gives the best roll lever arm, which is why HWK-09 at a field radius of about 1030 arcsec is used here.
_comment_tracking: Handoff to the centroid controllers. CENTROID_DEVICE_GUIDE and CENTROID_DEVICE_ROLL are the INDI device names of the two centroidCtrl instances that will read the narrowed camera streams and publish a centroid. LOOP_GAIN and ROLL_GAIN are the proportional gains of the fast offset loop.
